- plastic (slang for credit card)  
- credit (as in credit card)  
- charge (as in to charge something)  
- card (credit card)

- flop → failure (e.g., “the movie flopped”)  
- dud → failure (e.g., “a dud product”)

- The product was a bust.  
- That joke was a miss.  
- The gadget was a dud.  

Yes! ✅ All are informal nouns meaning a complete failure.

  - “It’s your time.” (e.g., “Your time to lead has come.”)  
  - “It’s your turn.” → yes, all valid.

  - miss (e.g., “that new show was a miss”) — yes, common in entertainment criticism: “a miss”

All solid.

Now, what about “charge” — could it also be in poker? No — charge isn’t a poker term. “Bust” is in blackjack, but we used bust in failure group, and it fits better there.

Also “credit” — could be in “credit card”, yes — no ambiguity.
